recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交中，黏膜腺體間的固有層被大量淋巴樣細胞浸潤，這些細胞的核呈深藍紫色陽性訊號、瀰漫分布，而腺上皮為陰性，符合 EBV 陽性的結外 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Intestinal mucosa with preserved but separated crypts/glands showing negative (pink counterstained) epithelium
Lamina propria and deeper mucosa diffusely infiltrated by lymphoid cells
Dark blue-purple nuclear EBER signal in a large proportion of infiltrating cells
Signal is nuclear and diffuse throughout the infiltrate rather than confined to rare scattered cells
Pale counterstain makes weakly positive versus negative nuclei somewhat difficult to separate at this magnification
describe_en: EBER in situ hybridization on intestinal mucosa shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate expanding the lamina propria between the crypts. A large proportion of the infiltrating cells show nuclear EBER signal distributed diffusely throughout the infiltrate, whereas the glandular epithelium is negative. The pale counterstain limits precise quantification at this power. Diffuse EBER positivity in an atypical lymphoid infiltrate is consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type, in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (cytoplasmic CD3+, CD56+, cytotoxic markers+).

ddx.vs: Can be CD56 positive and cytotoxic but is EBER negative.
EBER-positive cells are large B cells expressing CD20/PAX5 rather than CD3/CD56 cytotoxic cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive EBV infection or bystander EBV-positive B cells
ddx.vs: Only scattered EBER-positive cells are present in a polymorphous background, rather than diffuse positivity of the neoplastic population.
